prompt: Create ONE unique transparent PNG illustration for the indicated LeetCode problem, using the attached images strictly as character and visual STYLE REFERENCES, not as a collage to copy. Sparse flat 2D cartoon sketch, slightly irregular teal outlines, cream round heads, dot eyes, soft geometric bodies, thin limbs. Female has teal ponytail, curved forelock, peach shirt; male has short teal tuft, mustard shirt. Same recurring duo, proportions and simple faces as references. Cream/peach/mustard/mint palette, blue only where useful. Reference characters must remain recognizable; accessories may vary. Layout MUST be one LONG SHALLOW HORIZONTAL STRIP, about 6:1 content aspect ratio, e.g. 1536x256. If canvas must be taller, keep artwork in central shallow strip with TRANSPARENT unused margins so it can be trimmed. NO background, no white rectangle, no checkerboard, genuine alpha throughout empty space including between objects. Opaque interiors. No panel borders or speech bubbles, no scenery, gradients, 3D or photorealism. Keep a few prominent task objects and one or two small characters. Minimal text; no title, captions, solution steps, algorithm diagrams or explanatory formulas. Illustrate premise, not solving strategy. Strong enough strokes to be legible on light AND dark UI. Leave safe padding and do not clip objects. Specific scene:  COMPOSITION EMPHASIS: Build a very thin banner across the canvas, using SMALL WAIST-UP character busts at the ends, not tall full-body characters. Objects span nearly the entire width. Target visible artwork width/height at least 5:1; on a 2168px-wide canvas all ink should fit inside a 350px-high central band, leaving genuine transparent margins above and below. 1324 Print Words Vertically. Female small peach beret bust holds phrase card "HOW ARE YOU". Arrow to a compact three-by-three letter-tile arrangement with rows H A Y / O R O / W E U. Thus vertical columns read HOW, ARE, YOU and horizontal output rows HAY, ORO, WEU. Male small mustard-shirt printer bust holds a blank page, no additional text. Accurate unchanged letters, aligned grid, no reversing letters or algorithm. Phrase and tiny tiled output spread across long shallow scene.
